CustomField.description: Server-stamped, fail-closed marker read by the Nue pricing/product-rule plug-ins. Set true only when ELV_PricingControl.isActive() resolves true for the running user (CMT master switch AND pilot user match). The plug-in never evaluates user identity itself — it only trusts this field, defaulting to inactive when absent or false.
CustomField.label: Pilot Gate Active
